title: SciOrch: Learning to Orchestrate Expert LLMs for Solving Frontier Multimodal Scientific Reasoning Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2606.15872v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Frontier scientific reasoning remains a major challenge for large language models (LLMs), where even the strongest commercial systems fall short of expert-level performance. A closer look at model behavior reveals substantial complementarity that single-model evaluation hides: different frontier models excel on different question types, and no single model captures the full picture. We present SciOrch, a framework that trains a lightweight 8B model to orchestrate frontier LLMs for scientific reasoning. The orchestrator decomposes each question, delegates sub-problems to selected commercial models through API calls, and synthesizes a final answer. Training such an orchestrator is fundamentally harder than conventional agentic RL: each action triggers an API call that is expensive in both dollar cost and latency, making standard online rollouts infeasible. translated_title: SciOrch：学习编排专家级大语言模型以解决前沿多模态科学推理任务
translated_abstract: 前沿科学推理仍然是大语言模型（LLM）面临的一项重大挑战，即使是最强大的商业系统也难以达到专家级的性能。对模型行为的深入观察揭示了单模型评估所掩盖的显著互补性：不同的前沿模型在不同类型的问题上各有所长，没有任何单一模型能够全面覆盖所有情况。我们提出了SciOrch，一个训练轻量级8B模型来编排前沿LLM进行科学推理的框架。该编排器将每个问题分解，通过API调用将子问题委派给选定的商业模型，并综合生成最终答案。训练这样的编排器从根本上比传统的智能体强化学习更为困难：每个动作都会触发一次在金钱成本和延迟方面都很昂贵的API调用，使得标准的在线 rollout 变得不可行。我们采用基于MCTS的方法来应对这一挑战，生成多样化的编排轨迹。
tldr: SciOrch提出训练一个轻量级8B模型作为编排器，通过分解科学推理问题、调用多个前沿商业LLM并综合答案来达到专家级性能，并创新性地采用基于MCTS的方法生成训练轨迹，克服了API调用成本过高导致在线强化学习不可行的难题。
en_tdlr: SciOrch trains a lightweight 8B orchestrator model to decompose frontier scientific reasoning questions, delegate sub-problems to selected commercial LLMs via API calls, and synthesize final answers, employing an MCTS-based approach to generate diverse orchestration trajectories and overcome the infeasibility of standard online RL caused by costly and high-latency API calls.
